name: Self-Sabotage
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level mesmerist 1, psychic 1, spiritualist 1; Focus supremacy 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard or immediate action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close
Target one creature
Duration until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target is tricked into undermining its own actions. The next time it would succeed on a roll, check or saving throw, or when failing any of the above by more would have a detrimental effect, it must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, the triggering roll, check or saving throw suffers a penalty equal to the difference between this spell’s saving throw DC and the result. If the result of the saving throw is a natural 1, the penalized result is treated as 1, regardless of the difference. R damage roll that resulted from an attack roll is penalized the same amount as that attack roll. The spell does not penalize saving throws made against it.

Self-Sabotage II

Level mesmerist 2, psychic 2, spiritualist 2; Focus supremacy 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Saving Throw Will partial (see text)

DESCRIPTION

As self-sabotage I, except as noted above, and the target must continue to attempt saving throws or suffer the penalty until a roll, check or saving throw that would otherwise succeed fails due to the penalty. This spell can be undercast.

Self-Sabotage III

Level mesmerist 3, psychic 3, spiritualist 3; Focus supremacy 3

DESCRIPTION

As self-sabotage II, except as noted above, and the penalty suffered by the initial failed roll, check or saving throw is instead applied to every roll, check or saving throw the target attempts, reduced by one each subsequent time. The spell is discharged when the penalty inflicted the following time would be 0. This spell can be undercast.
